summary: CLI opens vendor-controlled WebSocket that drives a local shell/PTY and arbitrary command execution
details: The `start` CLI in @ai-support-agent/cli connects to a hardcoded WebSocket endpoint at wss://api.ai-support-agent.com/ws/agent-terminal and an AppSync notification channel, then routes inbound messages into local host execution. `handleStdin` base64-decodes network-supplied bytes and writes them directly into a spawned node-pty session (tmux/bash/zsh); `open` messages spawn new PTY sessions. In parallel, `AGENT_COMMAND` notifications dispatch to handlers including `execute_command` (shell exec via `executeShellCommand`), `file_read`, `file_write`, `file_delete`, `file_mkdir`, `process_kill`, and `ssh_exec`. The vendor endpoint therefore holds full interactive shell and filesystem control over any host running the CLI, with the local process attaching outbound to the WebSocket (bypassing inbound firewalling). Additional components (dist/vscode/vscode-server.js, dist/browser/browser-local-server.js) bind local HTTP/WebSocket surfaces that shell out via child_process, and darwin-service.js / linux-service.js install the agent as a persistent per-user service that modifies PATH and auto-starts at login, extending the remote-control surface across reboots.
